Class FileInventoryRepository

java.lang.Object
learn.inventory.data.FileInventoryRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryRepository
public class FileInventoryRepository extends Object implements InventoryRepository
Saves inventory products to a text file and loads them back into the application.

Each product is stored as a tab-separated record. The saved product type allows the repository to recreate either a StandardProduct or a PerishableProduct when the file is loaded.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public void save(List<Product> products) throws IOException
      Saves every product to the configured inventory file.

      The parent directory is created when it does not already exist. Existing file contents are replaced with the current inventory.

      Specified by:
      save in interface InventoryRepository
      Parameters:
      products - products to save
      Throws:
      IOException - if the directory or file cannot be created or written

    • load

      public List<Product> load() throws IOException
      Loads all valid product records from the configured inventory file.

      Blank lines are ignored. Each nonblank line is converted into the correct concrete product type.

      Specified by:
      load in interface InventoryRepository
      Returns:
      products reconstructed from the inventory file
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or contains invalid data

    • formatProduct

      private String formatProduct(Product product)
      Converts a product into one tab-separated file record.

      Products that implement Expirable include an expiration date. Standard products use an empty expiration-date field.

      Parameters:
      product - product to convert
      Returns:
      formatted product record ready to be written to the file
